name: Complete APE0 3D-Printable FDM Ape Body Assembly
user_statement: Alright please commit, upload, cleanup everything. And then do a review of the task and mark the task as done.
scope: Selected complete 3D-printable FDM structural integration of the 50 cm APE0 ape robot (cove50-complete-fdm-body-r1), uniting all four completed FDM structural subsystems: (1) Bilateral 6-Stage Lower Body (cove50-complete-leg-hip-fdm-combined-r10, M-y8acff, 12 printed parts + 128 sleeves, 187.64 g vs 332.78 g baseline, -43.61%, min SF 2.86x), (2) Bilateral 4-Stage Upper Body / Arms & Geared Hands (cove50-arm-fdm-combined-r12, M-d34p89, 8 primary arm parts + 8 printed geared-hand parts + 68 sleeves, 74.74 g primary arm structure vs 136.05 g baseline, -45.06%, min SF 1.65x), (3) 4-Stage Neck & Head (cove50-neck-head-fdm-combined-r1, M-8jkx67, 4 printed parts + 34 sleeves, 28.56 g vs 52.67 g baseline, -45.78%, min SF 2.34x), and (4) 4-Stage Center-Body Torso, Pelvis, 9-Cell Honeycomb Battery & Electronics Carrier (cove50-torso-fdm-combined-r1, M-h3aaq6, 4 printed parts + 76 whole-body sleeves / 86 standalone sleeves, 178.21 g vs 251.82 g baseline, -29.23%, min SF 1.55x). Includes 36 printed FDM parts total (28 primary structural parts + 8 geared-hand parts), 306 pressed-in 304 SS compression sleeves in the whole-body audit (316 in standalone subsystem rollup), 9 vertical 21700 battery cells + 9 direct-on-battery 6063-T5 Al heat-sink fins, 22 actuators (with black anodized hip C047 motors), 26 kinematic joints driven by 24 interactive DOF controls, and smooth closed round exterior shells (center_front_shell, center_back_shell, R/L_shoulder_hard_cover, R/L_upper_arm_hard_cover, R/L_fore_front/back_hard_cover, R/L_thigh_front/back_hard_cover, R/L_shin_front/back_hard_cover) with 0.0000 mm^3 overlap across all 8 whole-body poses, 32 arm poses, and 22 hip/leg/electronics/shell poses. Physical print tolerances, press-fit sleeve retention, bolt preload relaxation, enclosed-shell battery thermal cycling, and learned-control transfer remain separate.
qualification_limits: Selected Complete APE0 3D-printable FDM Ape Body CAD integration, 8-pose whole-body exact BRep collision audit (0.0000 mm^3 overlap), 32-pose arm collision audit (0.00 mm^3), 22-pose hip/leg/electronics/shell collision audit (0.00 mm^3), and print-bed nesting audit (100% single-piece fit on 256x256 mm bed across 4 plates or 350x350 mm bed across 2 plates), backed by subsystem linear P1 tetrahedral FEM solves (min SF 1.55x-2.86x across PAHT-CF dry). Physical print tolerances, press-fit sleeve retention, bolt preload relaxation, harness service loops, enclosed-shell battery thermal cycling, and closed-loop learned-control transfer remain unqualified.
